svg.title: AI Gateway on existing networking
svg.desc: A private request path on an existing network foundation. The platform retains network and DNS ownership; Terraform adds gateway, models and supporting resources.

text.tspan: Private access using existing networking and central DNS.
Subnet roles are logical: PE roles may share a subnet; gateway integration stays separate.
ALSO PROVISIONED · OUTSIDE THE REQUEST PATH
Optional: private hosted-agent extension · Blob private endpoint · private test VM
Reference design · Gateway/models: staged private-only target · Target environment requires validation
